credits.title: Save the Last Bullet
credits.overview: Based on events from the Balkan Wars. 1991: Amidst the cruel battle of Vukovar, a brave squad of Croatian soldiers fights its way through the besieged country to deliver a truck full of weapons to the Serbian border.

credits.title: Someone Dies Tonight
credits.overview: A group of friends sets out on a holiday road trip to Greece. On their way south, they are intercepted by a group of Croatian gangsters. Locked in a remote house, they find themselves struggling for their lives.

credits.title: Order of the Dragon
credits.overview: In a world teetering on chaos, elite assassin John Rico is the go-to solution when the government wants threats removed-quietly and permanently. But when a mission goes sideways, he's given one last shot at redemption: track down and eliminate Mason Ryker, the final ghost of the feared underground unit known as The Ord

credits.title: Citizen Vigilante
credits.overview: A man takes justice into his own hands, hunting down criminals. His vigilante crusade makes him a social media star but puts him at odds with the local police chief.

credits.title: A Man Worth Killing
credits.overview: After a series of brutal murders, and orders from The Big Boss, two callous and cold killers continue their bloodshed, only wanting to eliminate a weak old man, who is actually their biggest obstacle, but also a great threat to their unscrupulous plan.

credits.title: Devil's Work
credits.overview: When a couple, traveling on their vacation, meet a desperate girl seeking for her missing sister, they encounter with unspeakable terror and end up as hostages for a sick, bizarre and sadistic twisted mind family led by their deformed monster son.

credits.title: Wrongful Death 2: Bloodlines
credits.overview: After being employed by the Senator's wife to find the killer of their daughter, a determined detective begins an investigation in which the only evidence he finds are new waves of murders with no sign pointing to the identity of the killer.

credits.title: Wrongful Death
credits.overview: Captured inside the darkness of the strange, designed room, a narcissistic journalist and a mean sinful woman learn the hard way that the truth cannot be buried forever and what begins quite harmlessly, ends in a game of life and death.

credits.title: C.L.E.A.N.
credits.overview: Inside a remote rehab sanatorium, four newly arrived patients, each one with a specific emotional damage, go through hell by discovering and enduring the vicious methods of the sinister doctor's treatments, attempting to stay alive.
